description: This file defines the NotesRepository class which manages note data operations, acting as an intermediary between the data access object (DAO) and application logic. It handles creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and syncing notes, integrating with external classes such as NotesDao, Clock, and the Note model.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage notes data, including CRUD operations, synchronization, and real-time updates through streams.

methods.name: watchNotes
methods.description: Returns a stream of notes matching the given query, allowing real-time updates.

methods.name: watchNote
methods.description: Returns a stream of a specific note identified by id for real-time observation.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default values and assigns a unique ID, timestamped with the current time.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Updates or creates a note with given id, title, and content, preserving the original creation time if it exists.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted by updating its status and timestamp.

methods.name: getNotesForPush
methods.description: Retrieves notes that need to be pushed to a remote server.

methods.name: markNotesSyncing
methods.description: Marks specified notes as currently syncing.

methods.name: markNotesPushedClean
methods.description: Marks specified notes as synced and clean, updating their last sync time.

methods.name: markNotesFailed
methods.description: Marks specified notes as failed to sync.

methods.name: getLastSyncAtMillis
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last successful sync in milliseconds.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Reconciles local notes with a list of remote notes.

methods.name: purgeSyncedTombstones
methods.description: Removes tombstone records for synced notes.
